trial_court: Family Court No.2, Ajmer, case No. 206/2020
case_name: Neelam Tailor vs Shri Nitin Verma
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of application under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act from Family Court to court of Adl. District & Sessions Judge.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the parties to the lis have a right to seek transfer of the case.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that in matrimonial proceedings initiated by the husband against the wife, the convenience of the wife has to be considered for contesting the suit.
cited_cases: Vinisha Jitesh Tolani @ Manmeet Laghmani vs Jitesh Kishore Tolani, (2010) 1 WLC (SC) 705

legal_principles.principle: The territorial jurisdiction of this Court may order for transferring the application under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the court of Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Gulabpura, District, Bhilwara comes in the territorial jurisdiction of this Court.
cited_cases: Smt. Tilak Shekhawat Vs. Karan Singh Chouhan: SB Civil Transfer Petition No.23/2022, decided on 10.11.2022
Shilpa Vs. Deepak Tiwari : SB Civil Transfer Petition no.133/2022, decided on

outcome.final_order: Application under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act transferred to court of Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Gulabpura, District Bhilwara.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of cases between courts
